ink.$description: Ink — Headings and primary body text — near-black with a slight cool cast reads as authoritative without the harshness of pure #000

carbon.$description: Carbon — Body text and secondary headings — deeper than Ink, used where maximum contrast against white surfaces is needed

midnight.$description: Midnight — Primary action buttons (filled) — dark navy-black instead of pure black, giving CTAs a subtle blue undertone that harmonizes with the electric blue accent

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary body text, helper copy, muted descriptions under headlines

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text, nav links, subdued metadata — the lightest readable neutral before borders take over

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled state text, placeholder text, low-priority labels

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, input outlines, divider lines — cool blue-gray instead of pure gray so dividers feel on-brand

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, hero background — the dominant surface, occupying the majority of every viewport

snow.$description: Snow — Subtle section backgrounds, alternating bands — barely warmer than Paper, creates gentle visual rhythm without darkening the page

concrete.$description: Concrete — Muted surface fills, inactive chip backgrounds — sits between border and surface in the neutral stack

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Brand accent — checkmark icons, payment rate callouts, inline highlights, the single most prominent chromatic color across the page

iris.$description: Iris — Decorative accent and illustration fill — violet chip on invoice cards, secondary brand signal

magenta.$description: Magenta — Decorative accent and illustration fill — pink chip on invoice cards, tertiary brand signal

leaf.$description: Leaf — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

coral.$description: Coral — Red decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ice.$description: Ice — Tinted surface wash — light blue card backgrounds for highlight sections, soft accent backgrounds

lavender.$description: Lavender — Tinted surface wash — light violet card backgrounds for feature blocks

blush.$description: Blush — Tinted surface wash — light pink card backgrounds, decorative highlight blocks

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

open-runde.$description: Primary typeface for all headings and body text — geometric sans-serif with weight 600 at display sizes (64/48/40/32/24/20px) carrying -0.03em letter-spacing for compressed confident headlines; weight 500 for body (22/16/14px) with -0.02em tracking; 11px uppercase eyebrow labels at weight 600 with +0.02em tracking

caveat.$description: Handwritten signature font for testimonial attributions — creates human warmth against the geometric system at small sizes only

sf-pro-text.$description: Secondary system font for small uppercase labels — only used sparingly where system rendering is preferred over Open Runde

inter.$description: Inter — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
